Five named constant-buffer bindings and the core GBuffer/depth/screen-shadow/wetness/SSR/AO texture roles plus the binning byte-address buffer are now closed. Binding 32 is role-identified as the 48-byte _LightBinningConstants buffer, its exact native producer field layout and upload are source-closed, and a default-off Unity publisher is D3D11/D3D12 GPU-verified for source-closed isolated Overview light counts. Offline IL2CPP/xref recovery additionally closes LightCullResult as pointer+count, its unique HGCullingSystem.CullLights producer, both direct HGCamera.DoECSCulling call sites, their exact 256-candidate cap, and the first SetupState consumer. The target-frame native pointer contents/count and therefore final retail lightCount remain capture-only. Binding 34 is source-closed as the 11,440-byte ShadowData layout. Binding 37 now has its exact 32-entry/2,560-byte native initialization and upload closed; a default-off zero-cookie publisher is D3D11/D3D12 GPU-verified for the source-closed isolated Wulfa/Zhuangfy Overview lists, while non-empty retail atlas values remain capture-only. Binding 38 is source-closed as the exact 3,568-byte HDPunctualLightCharacterShadowData layout by a matching original ScreenSpaceShadowResolve sidecar; its native manager, per-frame reset, push-pass packing, selected .y-only consumer, active D16 atlas and RGBA8 screen-resolve resource lifecycle, and exact pre-bind capture boundary are now closed. The deferred binding is the resolved _HDPLSScreenSpaceShadowMask, while _HDPLSTex is the raw atlas input. The hash-pinned installed Persistent IFix table has 30 Gameplay.Beyond targets and replaces neither HDPLS wrapper-gated method, proving the recovered non-IFix branches are the current on-disk route; future/network patches remain a version boundary. An inactive frame clears all 56 channel selectors and binds white to both globals, preventing stale-frame reuse, but persistent/frame-derived fields and active pixels prevent claiming a byte-exact full fixture. All four debug-anonymous constant-buffer roles are therefore closed. Binary sampling behavior plus hash/offset-pinned installed shader identifiers close all 25 sampled texture roles. Exact installed CharInfo VolumeProfiles and HGEnvironmentPhase now source-close the scene's disabled wetness, volumetric-fog, cloud-shadow, ASM, and directional-shadow controls while proving that reflection remains live. All three serialized CharInfo BC6H Cubemaps are recovered exactly. The installed LightBinningXYCS and LightBinningZCS assets, all eight D3D11/Vulkan kernel programs, exact BinningData ABI, shared-buffer offsets, and XY/Z dispatch formulas are binary-source-closed. A default-off raw ByteAddressBuffer bridge composes the exact recovered light words with the source-closed zero-local-reflection tail and reads the full canonical _BinningBuffer back bit-exactly on D3D11 and D3D12. The installed ReflectionProbeBinningCS asset, exact one-Cubemap slice-0 host contract, 576x576x32 RGBAHalf oct cache, and 4,160-byte ReflectionProbeGlobalData producer are also binary-source-closed. The compatibility pipeline now co-publishes these reflection resources beside the preserved canonical buffer in the same camera command stream only when the exact T_hdri_env_char_01 asset and both readiness gates succeed; D3D11/D3D12 probes close the combined transport. The native VisibilitySHConstData b33 producer is now closed for all 128 bytes: it zero-fills the full source struct, overwrites fixed rows 0..2 and frame rows 3..4, then copies untouched zero rows 5..7. A default-off publisher reads all 32 words back bit-exactly on D3D11/D3D12 and joins the same fail-closed frame gate. Retail target-frame light survivors and pass-0 activation remain open. The retail deferred and volumetric binders close both selected disabled texture paths: invalid wetness is Unity's white Texture2D, while disabled volumetric fog publishes the game's exact 1x1x1 black ASTC_4x4 Texture3D. The retail capsule-shadow pass additionally closes the VisibilitySH output descriptor as bilinear/clamp R16G16B16A16_SFloat and its empty/disabled publication as Texture2D.blackTexture. Both exact LUT payloads, the native 128x48-byte output ABI, exact native posed transform-to-record packing, Wulfa/Zhuang's ten authored candidates, and the selected additive producer pass are also source-closed. Complete pass-0 publication, settled posed capsule records and view-cull survivors, and remaining live per-frame pixels are not yet closed.
